correctness.rationale: The all-size theorem follows from an exact iff support normal form for the only nontrivial order-comparable pairs, disjoint top-support cases for labelled counts, and independent-permutation-cycle incidence blocks for the fixed-point Burnside formula. In the bundled verify.py, direct quantified-FC checks exhaust all binary relations on six profiles of at most four worlds, rowwise checks verify three larger profiles up to five worlds, and direct permutation-invariant FC tests verify Burnside counts on (1,3),(2,2),(2,3). The theorem does not extrapolate finite data.

The full primary FIK manuscript was consulted for the axiom, semantic setting, examples, and conclusions; it gives axiomatization/countermodel results, not this enumeration. The complete published finite-chain FIK census was read and compared by implication: its chain-hypothesis cannot cover widths at least two and its counts contain no nontrivial order automorphism quotient. value.rationale: The complete height-two ordinal sum is the first natural branching extension beyond chain intuitionistic carriers, with both lower and upper incomparable worlds. The support condition is a structural classification and the explicit integer cycle-index formula handles all sizes and nontrivial relabelling symmetries. These counts have plausible direct use as finite modal-frame benchmarks and isolate effects of branching and order orientation; they are not a parameter substitution into the known chain Gaussian-binomial formula.
